recipes.name: Best Ever Slow Cooker Beef Stew
instructions: Place cut up beef in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and sear until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Depending on the size of your skillet, you might have to do this in batches, adding more olive oil if necessary.
Transfer the browned beef to a 6-quart slow cooker; arrange prepared carrots, celery, and mushrooms over the meat inside the slow cooker and set aside.
Heat the rest of the olive oil and sauté the onions for 3 minutes, or until softened.
Stir in the minced garlic and continue to sauté for 30 seconds, or until fragrant; transfer to the slow cooker.
Put the skillet back on the stove over medium-high heat and deglaze the pan with red wine. Scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to get all the browned bits; cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce; cook for 30 seconds while whisking.
Slowly whisk in 2 cups of beef broth; cook for 1 minute.
Pour the prepared liquid over the beef and vegetables.
Stir in the remaining broth into the slow cooker and add bay leaves and thyme over the veggies.
Close with a lid and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours, or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours. Times may vary depending on how hot your slow cooker runs.

30 minutes before the beef stew is done cooking, make a slurry by whisking together 2 tablespoons of cornstarch with 3 tablespoons of water. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker, set to HIGH, and continue to cook for 30 minutes.
When done, taste for seasonings and adjust accordingly

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Turkey Skillet

ingredients.name: 1/2 cups frozen/precooked brown rice (1 bag from Trader Joe’s)
broccoli florets, roughly chopped into bite size pieces
sour cream or Greek yogurt, optional

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, deep skillet with a lid over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes or until the onion has softened.

Increase the heat to medium-high and add the ground turkey. Using a meat masher or wooden spoon, break up the ground turkey as it browns. Once the turkey has just cooked through, about 5 minutes, add the seasonings, rice, broccoli, and chicken broth/water. Stir to combine then cover and cook over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes, or until broccoli is tender and the liquid has absorbed.*
Stir in 1/2 cup cheese and the sour cream or Greek yogurt until combined. Season to taste.
Top with remaining cheese and cover until melted, about 2 minutes. Top with parsley and serve hot!

ingredients.name: (1 lb) chicken thigh , cut into bite size pieces (Note 1)
(500 ml) milk (any, I use low fat)
1/4 cups (225g) long grain white rice , uncooked (Note 2)
dried thyme (or other herb of choice)
large head of broccoli, broken / cut into small florets (~400 – 500g / 14 oz – 1 lb) (Note 3)
(200g) shredded mozzarella or cheddar (or other cheese of choice) (Note 4)

instructions: Melt butter and heat oil in a pot over high heat. Add onion and garlic, cook for 1 minute. Add chicken and cook until it changes from pink to white. (Note 5)
Turn stove DOWN to medium. Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Add half the milk, stirring as you go, and once incorporated into the flour add the rest of the milk and stir.
Add broth, rice, thyme and a just pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir, bring to simmer, then cover. Turn down to medium low and cook for 12 minutes.
Remove lid – there should still be liquid on the surface. Working quickly, add broccoli, push down so it’s partly submerged, cover and cook for a further 3 minutes until broccoli is just cooked.

Preheat grill/broiler. Remove lid and stir through half the cheese – don’t worry if it looks a bit too saucy, excess liquid gets sucked up in minutes (see video). Smooth surface, top with remaining cheese. Grill/broil until melted (or just put lid on and allow to melt with residual heat on turned off stove).
Serve immediately, garnished with parsley if desired.
Recipe Notes:
1. CHICKEN: Thigh is better than breast because it’s fattier so they don’t dry out. This recipe would also work great with ground meat!

2. RICE: Long grain and medium grain rice are ideal in this because they are less “sticky” than short grain rice so it makes this come out like a creamy risotto. But it will work with short grain rice too. This will also work fine with basmati and jasmine rice, though you will get the added fragrance from these rices. I have not tried this with brown rice but it should work but it will take around 40 minutes to cook on low heat, then add the broccoli right at the end. You may need to top up with a bit of extra water.
Do not use risotto or paella rice – the liquid ratios in this recipe are not suited to these. I also have not tried this with quinoa, cauliflower rice or any non-rice alternatives!
3. Frozen Broccoli is fine to use in this recipe, but thaw first and ensure all excess liquid is drained.
4. Cheese: Any melting cheese is fine for this recipe.
5. Cooking chicken: It’s great if you can get some colour on it but don’t cook it all the way through and don’t let the base of the pot go too brown (discolours the sauce).

6. LEFTOVERS/MAKE AHEAD: This reheats much better than most rice casseroles because it’s nice and saucy, just keep it in the fridge 🙂 For make ahead, stop at the point after you stir the cheese in, cover and let it cool. Then sprinkle with cheese on top, refrigerate, then microwave to reheat / melt the cheese. I think this is the freshest way to make ahead.

7. Nutrition per serving (about 2 cups), assuming 5 servings and that this is made using low fat milk. CALORIE REDUCTION: Leave out all the cheese, stir through 1/2 cup parmesan instead then top with breadcrumbs, spray with oil. This will reduce the calories by about 100 calories per serving.
recipes.name: Broccoli, Chicken and Rice Casserole
Burgers (Family)
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook burger patties in batches according to package directions, flipping halfway through.
Heat baked beans in a saucepan over medium heat until hot, stirring occasionally.
Toast hamburger buns in the skillet, if desired.
Place cooked patties on buns and add desired toppings and condiments.
Serve 2 burgers per person with baked beans and potato chips.

recipes.name: Burgers (for Two)
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook burger patties according to package directions, flipping halfway through.
Heat baked beans in a small saucepan over medium heat until hot, stirring occasionally.
Toast hamburger buns in the skillet, if desired.
Place cooked patties on buns and add desired toppings and condiments.
Serve 2 burgers per person with baked beans and potato chips.

recipes.name: BYO Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Lightly spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray.
Unroll pizza dough onto baking sheet and press into desired shape.
Prebake crust for 8 minutes.
Spread pizza sauce, Alfredo sauce, or a combination of both over the crust.
Top with shredded cheese and desired toppings.
Bake for 6–10 minutes, until cheese is melted and crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 2–3 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Chicken Fries & Mac 'n' Cheese
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Cook chicken fries in batches according to package directions, shaking basket halfway through.
Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Add macaroni from all 3 boxes and cook according to package directions.
Drain macaroni and return it to the pot.
Add all 3 cheese packets and the milk and butter called for on the boxes.
Stir until creamy and well combined.
Serve chicken fries with mac 'n' cheese.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom & Chicken Casserole
instructions: Stir the soup, milk, corn, mushrooms, chicken, noodles, Parmesan cheese and black pepper in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 400°F. for 25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir the mixture and top with breadcrumbs or cheese (optional).

recipes.name: Ground Turkey and Broccoli Orzo

ingredients.name: Broccoli Florets, cut into small pieces
½ cups Low Sodium Chicken Broth

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 1 Tbsp olive oil. Add the broccoli and toss in the oil. Pan roast until the broccoli turns dark green and is slightly charred in places, about 5-6 minutes. Set aside.
Add the remaining 1/2 Tbsp olive oil and the ground turkey. Brown one side for 3-4 minutes before breaking apart and fully cooking.

Once cooked, push to one side of the pan and add the orzo. Toast for 1-2 minutes until golden before adding the lemon pepper seasoning, lemon juice, dijon, and chicken broth. Stir everything together, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring every 2-3 minutes, until the broth is absorbed.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the butter, milk, and freshly grated parmesan. Add the roasted broccoli and stir everything together.
Serve with freshly grated black pepper and parmesan, chili flakes, a drizzle of olive oil or Calabrian chili oil, and a squeeze of lemon juice.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Skillet
instructions: Add oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion, diced mushrooms and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Add in ground turkey and cook until cooked through. Drain any excess grease.
Stir in stock, rice, and onion soup mix. Heat until stock starts to boil. Reduce heat to simmering. Cover the skillet with lid and cook for 15 minutes. Stir halfway through.
Remove from heat and add shredded cheese. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Honey-Glazed Chicken Thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil, salt, and pepper; spread on baking sheet.
In a bowl, mix honey, mustard, soy sauce, garlic, and 1 tablespoon oil.
Rub mixture over chicken. Place chicken on same sheet as potatoes.
Roast 35–40 minutes, turning potatoes halfway, until chicken is golden
Form ground beef into 4 equal patties. Season to your liking.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties 4–5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Warm gravy in a small saucepan or microwave according to jar directions.
In the same skillet, cook eggs to preference.
Serve beef patties topped with warm gravy and eggs.
recipes.name: Loco Moco

instructions: Put beef in skillet and add taco seasoning.
Put chips in round baking pans, layered with beef, cheese and salsa (optional)
Bake at a temperature for 10 min
recipes.name: Nachos
Parmesan Spinach Mushroom Pasta
instructions: To make the parmesan spinach mushroom pasta skillet, Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, according to the package instructions.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet. Add the mushrooms and sauté for about 3 minutes until lightly browned.
3. Add the chopped garlic and cook for about 30 seconds longer.
Then deglaze with a bit of vegetable broth. Reduce the heat and cook for about 1-2 minutes longer.
Remove mushrooms to a plate and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
5. Once the pasta is ready, pour off the cooking water. Push spinach on the side in the skillet and add mushroom back, then put drained pasta in the pan and toss to combine.
Add parmesan, the last tablespoon of olive oil, and Italian seasoning, and give a quick stir.
Serve the parmesan spinach mushroom pasta with red chili pepper flakes and more parmesan, if you like. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Pasta & Garlic Bread (Family)
instructions: Preheat oven according to Texas toast package directions.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add pasta and cook according to package directions.
Pour pasta sauce into a small saucepan and heat over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally.
Arrange Texas toast on a baking sheet.
Bake Texas toast according to package directions until golden brown.
Drain cooked pasta.
Return pasta to the pot and toss with the warmed pasta sauce.
Serve pasta with 1–2 slices of garlic bread per person.
Preheat oven according to Texas toast package directions.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add pasta and cook according to package directions.
Pour pasta sauce into a small saucepan and heat over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally.
Arrange Texas toast on a baking sheet.
Bake Texas toast according to package directions until golden brown.
Drain cooked pasta.
Return pasta to the pot and toss with the warmed pasta sauce.
Serve pasta with 1–2 slices of garlic bread per person.
recipes.name: Pasta & Garlic Bread (for Two)

instructions: Add onion and garlic to the bottom of the slow cooker.
Place pork on top and season to your liking.
Mix BBQ sauce, broth, and apple cider vinegar; pour over the pork.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8–10 hours or HIGH for 5–6 hours, until pork shreds easily.
Remove pork and shred with two forks.
Return shredded pork to the slow cooker and stir into the sauce before serving.
recipes.name: Pulled Pork

instructions: Slice sausages into bite-sized rounds.
Pan-sear until browned (about 5 minutes).
recipes.name: Sausage Bites
Sheet Pan Chicken and Sweet Potatoes with Broccoli

ingredients.name: pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts
medium sweet potatoes (or 1 large) peeled and cubed (¾-1 inch)
tablespoons extra virgin olive oil divided
¾ teaspoon salt plus more to taste

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed sheet pan with parchment paper.
Add sweet potatoes to the sheet pan. Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil, ¼ teaspoon salt, and a pinch of pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
While the sweet potatoes roast, pat the chicken dry. Toss in a medium bowl with remaining olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, turmeric (if using), remaining salt, and pepper.

Remove the pan from the oven. Push sweet potatoes to one side, add chicken and broccoli to the pan, spreading everything out in an even layer. Drizzle remaining ½ tablespoon of olive oil over the broccoli and season with salt and pepper.
Return to the oven and roast for 18-22 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F and the vegetables are tender with crisp edges.
Squeeze fresh lemon over everything, sprinkle with parsley or flaky salt if desired, and serve warm.

recipes.name: Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Slice open each chicken breast on its side with a knife and spread one cheese wedge per piece of chicken inside the slit. Then stuff spinach and red onion slices inside chicken on top of cheese.
Place chicken in a glass baking dish and season with salt and pepper. Cover dish with foil and bake at 425°F for 45–60 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken breasts.
Spoon the spinach mixture into each chicken breast evenly.
Place the chicken breasts in a 9 × 13-inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 25–30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 1½-quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Set aside.
Pour olive oil into a saucepan over medium heat. Add in diced onion and cook until soft. Now add garlic and peppers. Cook until peppers are softened.
Crumble turkey into pepper mixture. Brown and then drain.
Add cooked rice and then salt, tomato sauce and spices. Stir in ¼ cup mozzarella cheese. Pour into prepared dish. Top with remaining ¼ cup cheese.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes, until bubbly. Serve up and enjoy!
recipes.name: Stuffed Pepper Casserole
Taco Casserole
instructions: Saute meat, beans, onions, taco seasoning, sauce, and corn on medium-high heat until meat is browned (or soy crumbles are thoroughly cooked).
Spoon half your meat mixture into your casserole dish in an even layer, top with a thin layer of sour cream, then sprinkle with some cheese.
Repeat. Cover with cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

data.title: My First Kiss Went a Little Like This

posts.md:
The sounds of laughter and rowdy pent up angsty energy filled the air in an increasing volume. [[Ezra]] hovered outside the school gym waiting for [[Raven]] & [[Phey | Ophelia]] to finish getting changed and emerge from the girls’ locker room. It was the end of the school day so there was a lot of hustle and bustle going on outside the middle school. He kept his gaze on the ground and kicked around the dirt at his feet, trying not to draw attention to himself as his peers passed him by; however, this trick didn’t work when you’re being specifically targeted. 

“What’s up, homo? You out here day dreaming about being a girl?” The voice was undeniably his older brother, [[JC]]. The group of young teenage boys chuckled at the insult, and one of them muttered a gay slur under his breath.

The younger brother shakes his head and rolls his eyes, “Leave me alone, JC, you know I’m just waiting for my friends.”

“Your female friends,” Archer, his brother’s second in command, notes with a shrug, “Funny how you don’t have any guy friends… that’s pretty gay, dude.”

Ezra sighs and shakes his head, “At least girls will talk to me.”

“Yeah, but you’ve never kissed one, have you?” JC taunts.

The color that rushes into Ezra’s cheeks only riles up the older group of boys even more, so he drops his gaze to the ground again. They’re still teasing him and making kissy faces at him as Raven and Phey come out from the locker rooms

“What’s all the noise about?” Phey asks, immediately taking her spot by her best friend’s side, and Raven flanking him on the other.

 The energy of the older boys immediately shifts; for most of them, their crush had just entered the chat. There was an immediate cacophony of mumbled excuses and denial, so Phey turned to the victim for his version of events.

At first, Ezra purses his lips, not wanting to embarrass himself in front of more people, especially her. It’s mere seconds before he gives a defiant huff to signal his surrender. “They were calling me gay and saying I’ve never kissed a girl and stuff.”

Phey nods as she processes the information and waits to make sure he’s finished before responding. A smirk dances across her lips as she says, “Oh, is that all?” She pauses a moment, having a flair for the dramatic, before grabbing Ezra by the collar and pulling him into a kiss. She pulls away from the quick peck with the proud smirk back on her lips; he remains utterly stunned. 

Then she turns back to the gaggle of older boys with a satisfied grin and says, “There. Now he has kissed a girl. Can all of you say that?”

The cacophony of mumbled excuses and denials chimes in again.

The younger trio begins to walk away, but Phey stops and turns back to the boys she just put in their place. “Oh, and by the way, using gay as an insult is immature and makes you sound dumb. There’s nothing wrong with being queer but plenty wrong with being hateful.” Then she shrugs and turns back to her friends as they walk away with their heads held high.

Ezra can’t seem to stop smiling the entire walk home.

It was the second week of **June 2024** when the first true heatwave of the summer struck. It was the sticky kind of humid heat that drove everyone indoors to their central air conditioned homes - for those who were lucky enough to have it.

As one of the heirs of the [[founding families]], the [[Everharts]] had an expansive estate, which included a temperature and weather controlled [[guest house]] on the far side of the pool from the perspective of the main house. Ezra had discovered the value of this separate building a few years prior while looking to escape from [[JC]] & [[Archer]]’s harassment; he didn’t believe for a second that they ‘just wanted to see if he still fit in the suitcase’. At any rate, he was still technically home, and his brother and friends had access to all of the higher quality televisions and consoles and food, so they had very little reason to bother coming out back - even just to torture him.

That was how it became the regular hang out spot for the trio that affectionately referred to themselves as ‘[[Phezrave]]’ - a portmanteau of the members: [[Phey | Ophelia “Phey” Montgomery]], [[Ez | Ezra Cody Everhart]] and [[Raven | Raven Jane Hawthorne]]. All three of them were from founding families, which meant they had grown up together - attending family and town events together, growing up in the same neighborhood, and so on. They were the youngest children of the most recent generation, so they were sort of best friends by default, but they did all get along and were fiercely protective of one another.

The three recent middle school graduates sat around the coffee table playing a card game where they could only speak in one syllable words when the outside door opened. Three different voices came spilling in and each of the trio had a different reaction. Ezra froze - three voices meant it wasn’t just a parent grabbing something or a staff member coming to clean. Besides, he recognized the voices and knew it was best to fear them and stay vigilant. Raven was a frustrated level of annoyed; not quite rolling her eyes, a bit more perturbed by the disturbance than that. Phey was a different kind of annoyed - less frustrated by their existence and more upset that the game was interrupted. She’s the first to speak up and say, “What are you guys doing here?”

[[JC | Joshua Collin Everhart]] - more infamously known as JC - had an amused smirk dance across his lips. “Um, last time I checked, I was the one who actually lived here,” he pointed out. This got a chuckle out of his cronies - Archer C. Hawthorne and [[Paisley Lockwood]] - a sort of delinquent trio of their own. 

This time Phey actually rolls her eyes and says, “You know what I mean… We usually hang out here so that you guys can have the whole house to yourself,” she reminds them as if it were some sort of established treaty between rival sibling gangs.

“Well, now we want to hang out here,” Archer shrugs, rummaging through the snacks the Phezrave trio had accumulated over several hang out sessions. “It has a certain… No snooping parents vibe that we want to take advantage of.” This notion seems to really excite Paisley who had never looked more like a wide eyed bimbo than she did in that moment.

“We could just move inside,” Ezra mutters, barely enough for his friends to hear.

Raven scowled as she replied, “But we shouldn’t have to.”

“Alright, alright,” JC says, holding his hands up as if in surrender, “Look, we got our hands on a bottle… And we were hoping to drink it out here, outside of mom and dad’s general vicinity. But… Perhaps a deal can be made.” His devious smile deepens as he continues, “If one of you take a shot of this vodka, we’ll go back inside the main house.”

Raven scoffs and says, “It’s probably toilet water or something gross.” After all, she had lived with Archer her entire life, she knew what he was capable of - especially if Ezra was their victim.

The older Everhart smirked at the accusation, as he twisted the cap off the bottle and took a noticeable swig himself, wincing lightly at the burn. “See? It’s not,” he explains. Then he pours some into a shot glass and hands it to Archer who doesn’t even blink before taking the shot. Then he pours another shot into the glass and puts it on the coffee table.

“And if one of us drinks that, you’ll leave us alone and go back inside? The main house, I mean,” Phey replies.

“We swearrr it,” Paisley says with a slur that sounds like she’d already had a few drinks herself.

As Phey looked around at the three older teens, she couldn’t help but compare them to the three hyenas from the animated Lion King, eager to pounce on those smaller and more innocent. Phey lets out a sharp breath, always willing to take one for the team - especially team Phezrave - and grabs the glass. Her nose wrinkles at the smell as she brings it closer and she hesitates.

“It’s easier if you do it fast,” Paisley coaches, seeming a bit impressed that she’d even picked up the shot.

Raven was less impressed. “Ophelia, don’t… This is literally peer pressure.”

“Oh, relax,” Phey says, she’d seen her older brother Grant take shots plenty of times before, it couldn’t be that terrible. With that, she lets out another sharp breath and takes the shot - quickly as had been suggested. Her nose wrinkles and she winces hard at the burning sensation as the room erupts into a range of reactions:

Ezra isn’t sure if he’s impressed, grateful or disappointed and somehow his expression conveys all three.
Raven is folding her arms across her chest, sneering in disgust.
Paisley is clapping and cheering for Phey, definitely finding the most fun in the situation.
Archer is shocked but impressed that Miss Goody Two Shoes with her soap box speeches was actually willing to drink alcohol.

JC’s reaction was a bit darker; he’s impressed, of course, but also delightfully intrigued. Was this the beginning of Ophelia’s reckless and rebellious phase? If so, what could he do to fan that flame to burn brighter.

Phey, on the other hand, felt proud of herself for sticking up for her friends, but not great about taking the shot - especially because she didn’t hate it. Still, she did what JC asked and therefore the agreement had to be honored. “Alright, back to the main house,” Phey reminds them. 

The older teens grumble but concede and make their way back out. JC can be heard saying, “I didn’t think they’d do it…”

Ezra’s frozen state seems to melt and he shakes his head saying, “You didn’t have to do that.”

“That was stupid,” Raven adds.

Phey shrugs and says, “Hey, it kept us and our sanctuary safe. I’m not mad about it.”
